Paragraph: On hearing the words of Hanuma, Lakshmana motivated by Rama, narrated about the great soul Rama, the son of Dasharatha.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Responding to Hanuman's inquiry about their identity and purpose.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana, encouraged by Rama, narrates their family lineage and history.
Outcome/Resolution: Transparent disclosure of background is provided.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Truthful disclosure (satya-kathana) builds foundational trust between allies.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reciprocal self-disclosure to deepen interpersonal safety and transparency.
